title: Website-Based Digitalization of Putro Agung Sports Field Management in Rangkah Subdistrict, Surabaya City
description: This activity aims to digitalize the management system of Putro Agung sports field through a website-based platform to improve administrative efficiency and service accessibility.

title: Enhancing Understanding of Machine Learning Implementation for Students of SMK Negeri 1 Bangil to Improve Competence in the Field of Information Technology Engineering

title: Improving the Mental Health of Indonesian Migrant Workers in Thailand: Screening, Support, and Education within a Single Technology Platform
